title: Gen1WildQOL Nightly
author: Wild
summary: Nightly. The quality-of-life half of the suite in one mod: sprinting, autosave, auto continue, sound, followers, all 151, EXP share, the move reminder, menu layout and the mod manager. Every feature switches on and off by itself. Runs on Gold, Silver and Crystal too, where it adds ALL 251 and switches on Crystal's own CELEBI event.
